name: typescript
about: A TypeScript repository whose tests run with npm test (Vitest or Jest), as *.test.ts files next to the code under src/, type-checked with tsc and linted with eslint. It has no rules file, no frozen paths and no extra suite, and commits with plain git commit.

vars.LINT_CMD: npx tsc --noEmit && git diff --name-only --diff-filter=d "$BASE" -- '*.ts' '*.tsx' | xargs -r npx eslint
